topic: Realtime data calibration and deployment plan
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the real-time data pipeline, specifically how changes in ML data (staging) would affect current production data. It was clarified that the existing real-time feed will continue to use old parameters for both the current model and the new analytics aggregate.

Key adjustments include:
*   **Calibration:** A correct calibration process is expected, which involves separate calibrations for the current model and the new ML model.
*   **Dwell Time:** The changes are expected to correctly cut off extreme dwell-time spikes observed in real-time data.
*   **Deployment:** Testing of the updated system (including the new analytics aggregate) will occur this evening, followed by a planned launch tomorrow.
decisions: The existing real-time feed will use old parameters for both the current model and the new ML analytics aggregate.
action_items: Test and run the updated system with [p1] this evening.
